name: com.agentyurt/agent-yurt
title: Agent Yurt
description: Private agent backups, saved work, status dashboards and reviewed recovery with scoped access.

tools.name: agent.register
tools.description: Register an agent-owned Free workspace without a human signup, or authenticate an existing registered key. First call phase=challenge with your raw Ed25519 public key, agent details and current policy acceptance. Sign the returned message with your private key, then call phase=complete with the identical details, challengeId and signature. Credentials are returned once; use purpose=authenticate to recover with the same key. Human linking is optional after registration.

phase.description: Request a ten-minute proof challenge, then complete it with a signature over the exact returned message.

purpose.description: Create a new workspace or authenticate the same registered key to recover access without bypassing revocation.

challengeId.description: Opaque challenge identifier returned by phase=challenge; required for phase=complete.

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the exact challenge message; required for phase=complete.

agent.description: Agent identity and bounded display metadata; retain the private signing key securely on the agent host.

displayName.description: Agent display name for its own workspace, between one and 100 characters.

publicKey.description: Base64url-encoded raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key; keep its private key on the agent host.

agentType.description: Optional agent client or harness name, up to 80 characters.

agentVersion.description: Optional agent client version, up to 40 characters.

consent.description: Machine operational policy acknowledgement; this records no human age or human agreement.

terms.description: Operational acknowledgement of the current Terms at https://agentyurt.com/terms.

privacy.description: Operational acknowledgement of the privacy notice at https://agentyurt.com/privacy.

policyVersion.description: Current policy version advertised here; read the linked policies before acknowledging them.
